title: Sell Mineral Rights in Beebe, AR
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Beebe, AR | White County
metaDescription: Own gas rights near Beebe, Arkansas on the Fayetteville Shale's eastern flank? We evaluate White County legacy production and make a cash offer with no obligation.
heroLead: Beebe is White County's second-largest town, sitting on the eastern flank of the Fayetteville Shale play where wells were generally thinner than the core counties to the west.
intro: Southwestern Energy and other operators drilled through this part of White County during the Fayetteville Shale's peak years between roughly 2005 and 2012, but the eastern flank of the play never matched the productivity of Faulkner and Van Buren counties toward its core. That history still matters for owners: even flank-area interests generated real production and royalty history, and many were sold or transferred without the family ever getting a clear picture of current status.

sections.heading: Flank position versus core Fayetteville Shale counties
paragraphs: Wells drilled around Beebe generally produced less per lateral than wells closer to the play's structural core, and operators pulled back activity here earlier as gas prices softened after the 2012 peak. That doesn't mean interests here have no value, it means we price them against actual current decline data for White County wells rather than against headline numbers from the play's best counties.

sections.heading: Who operates legacy wells here today
paragraphs: Southwestern Energy sold most of its Fayetteville Shale assets to Flywheel Energy in 2018, and BKV Corporation later acquired that position in 2021, so a well originally drilled by SEECO may now be operated by a company your family has never heard of. If your royalty statements changed names at some point, that's a common and explainable shift, not a red flag.

sections.heading: Small, fractionalized interests around town
paragraphs: Beebe's proximity to Little Rock means a fair amount of land here has changed hands or been subdivided over the years, sometimes without the mineral estate being carried along cleanly. We work from your division order or deed to confirm exactly what fraction you hold before quoting a number.

faqs.question: Is White County part of the core Fayetteville Shale play?
faqs.answer: It's on the eastern flank, generally less productive per well than Faulkner or Van Buren counties to the west, but still part of the broader play with real production history.

faqs.question: The operator name on my check changed a few years ago. Is that normal?
faqs.answer: Yes. Southwestern Energy's Fayetteville Shale assets moved to Flywheel Energy and then to BKV Corporation, so a name change on your statement usually just reflects that ownership transfer.

faqs.question: My royalty checks from a Beebe-area well have gotten smaller over time. Is that expected?
faqs.answer: Yes, shale gas wells decline steeply after their first few years, and most Fayetteville Shale wells are now well past their peak. We price based on the current decline curve.
